name: apple-dev-docs-mcp
description: MCP server for Apple Developer Documentation - Search iOS/macOS/SwiftUI/UIKit docs, WWDC videos, Swift/Objective-C APIs & code examples in Claude, Cursor & AI assistants

scripts.types:docc: openapi-typescript https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swiftlang/swift-docc/main/Sources/SwiftDocC/SwiftDocC.docc/Resources/RenderNode.spec.json --default-non-nullable false -o src/types/docc/render-node.d.ts && openapi-typescript https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swiftlang/swift-docc/main/Sources/SwiftDocC/SwiftDocC.docc/Resources/RenderIndex.spec.json --default-non-nullable false -o src/types/docc/render-index.d.ts
scripts.types:captured:generate: quicktype --lang ts --src-lang json --just-types --no-enums --no-date-times --no-uuids --no-integer-strings --no-boolean-strings --top-level SearchStream --out src/types/captured/search-stream.ts api-map/responses/*.messages.json && quicktype --lang ts --src-lang json --just-types --no-enums --no-date-times --no-uuids --no-integer-strings --no-boolean-strings --top-level SearchDocument --out src/types/captured/search-document.ts api-map/responses/*.document.json && quicktype --lang ts --src-lang json --just-types --no-enums --no-date-times --no-uuids --no-integer-strings --no-boolean-strings --top-level TechnologiesPage --out src/types/captured/technologies.ts api-map/responses/technologies.json
